스테이지를 클리어하면 알이 하나씩 생겨요.
이 알을 부화기에 넣고 기다리면, 귀여운 오리 친구가 ‘삐약’ 하고 태어나요.
누가 나올지는 열어보기 전까지는 몰라요! 매번 설레는 마음으로 알을 열어보세요.
다양한 테마와 개성을 가진 오리들이 여러분을 기다리고 있어요.

- 음악에 따라 바뀌는 리듬 플레이
스테이지마다 분위기가 완전히 달라요.
귀엽고 경쾌한 곡부터 감성적인 피아노곡 까지!
음악에 따라 노트 패턴도 다르게 떨어져서, 같은 방식의 반복이 아니라 늘 새롭게 플레이할 수 있어요.
120곡이 넘는 다양한 음악이 준비되어 있으니, 오늘은 어떤 리듬을 즐겨볼까요?

- 쉽고 직관적인 조작, 손끝으로 느끼는 리듬감
게임 방법은 아주 간단해요.
떨어지는 노트에 맞춰 오리를 이동시키기만 하면 되죠.
처음 하는 사람도 금방 익숙해지고, 점점 리듬을 타는 재미에 푹 빠지게 될 거예요.

- 수집하는 재미가 가득한 오리 친구들
요리사 모자를 쓴 오리, 닌자 복장의 오리, 우주복을 입은 오리까지!
각양각색의 오리들이 저마다 다른 매력으로 등장해요.

시간이 지나면 알이 천천히 부화되고, 새로운 오리들이 찾아와요.
짧게 가볍게 즐길 수도 있고, 음악과 리듬에 빠져 오래 플레이해도 좋아요.

snippet.title: Merge Cat Town
snippet.description:
[Google Play Store]
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobirix.mgci

[Apple App Store]
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/merge-cat-town/id6743785079


Please create an island of cute cats.

Please build a village for cute cats to live on a peaceful but empty wasteland island. To create a beautiful cat island, you need to create a variety of items. 
Take out various items from the magic wooden box and combine the same items to create new items. 
Create various items that curious cats want, grow the village, decorate it beautifully, and let the cute cats have fun running around.

[How to play]
- Find new items in the magic tool box.
- You can create a new item by combining two items of the same type.
- You can synthesize and sell items that your cat wants, such as animals, plants, etc., and raise its level.
- As your level rises, you can grow your village through construction.

[Game Features]
- You can conveniently combine items through easy and intuitive operation.
- In addition to item synthesis, there are various events you can enjoy.
- You can enjoy an interesting and fun story by progressing through episodes as you grow Cat Island Village.
- When there is not enough space for synthesis, you can strategically store it in your bag for a while and synthesize it.
- Even if you make a mistake in combining, you can get it back by using disassembly items.
- You can help build cat villages and cities with rewards received through various events.
- You can enjoy the game anytime, anywhere offline even without WiFi or network connection.

[Various reward events]
- In the 'Bingo Event', you can receive rewards by combining and filling items horizontally, vertically and diagonally.
- By completing ‘Whisker’s Mission’, you can obtain items such as gold or gems.
- In ‘Pandora’s Box’, you can receive amazing and unpredictable rewards.
- You can receive rewards by completing orders with quick synthesis and winning in the ‘Cat’s Voyage Rush Competition Event’.
- Receive additional rewards when you complete various missions.
- Receive additional rewards even if you achieve achievements.
- You can receive various items as rewards just by running it every day and attending.

다양한 테마와 개성을 가진 오리들이 여러분을 기다리고 있어요.

- 음악에 따라 바뀌는 리듬 플레이
스테이지마다 분위기가 완전히 달라요.

snippet.title: Duet Ducks: Rhythm Game
snippet.description:
[Google Play Store]
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobirix.mbdtw

[Apple App Store]
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/duck-town/id6740374176


[Game Description]  
Enjoy a delightful rhythm game with an adorable duck family!  
Clear stages to earn eggs one by one.  
Place them in the incubator and wait—soon, a cute duckling will be born with a cheerful "chirp"!  
You never know which duck you'll get until the egg hatches. Every reveal is a surprise!  
Ducks with various themes and unique personalities are waiting for you.

- Rhythm gameplay that changes with the music  
Each stage has a totally different vibe.  
From cheerful, upbeat tunes to emotional piano melodies!  
Note patterns change with the music, so gameplay always feels fresh instead of repetitive.  
With over 120 songs available, what rhythm will you enjoy today?

- Simple, intuitive controls and satisfying rhythm feedback  
The game is very easy to play.  
Just move the duck to match the falling notes.  
Newcomers will quickly get the hang of it and soon be immersed in the rhythm!

- Adorable duck characters to collect  
A duck in a chef’s hat, a ninja duck, even one in a spacesuit!  
Each duck has its own unique charm.  
Collecting them one by one is fun, and gathering them in your village will bring a smile to your face.

- Build your very own duck village  
The village is a cozy space for your duck family.  
As more ducks are born and gather, the village fills with warmth and life.  
Watching your diverse ducks interact is soothing.  
Create your own special nest filled with your duck stories.

- A game to enjoy in short bursts or for long sessions  
Eggs hatch over time, and new ducks will arrive.  
You can play briefly in your spare moments, or dive deep into the rhythm and music.  
It’s a healing, heartwarming game perfect for any play style.

snippet.title: Apple Number Puzzle
snippet.description:
[Google Play Store]
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobirix.ldap

[Apple App Store]
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/apple-number-puzzle/id6743830496


Choose the number apple to make 10.

It is a highly addictive number puzzle game. You can complete the puzzle by selecting and removing the fruits by dragging.
Compete with global users in various game modes and show off your brain puzzle skills.

[How to play]
- You can select fruits within the range by dragging.
- If the sum of selected fruits is 10, they will be removed.
- To win, you must eliminate all fruits.
- If you cannot make 10 and can no longer remove fruits or do not remove them within the time limit, you will lose.

[Game Features]
- In puzzle mode, you can experience and challenge levels of increasing difficulty sequentially.
- You can experience puzzles of various rules with differentiated gimmicks.
- In classic mode, you can eliminate 170 fruits using the optimized UI.
- In the daily quiz, you can solve new problems every day and compete with other users through the provided national rankings.
- You can enjoy not only apples, but also bananas, oranges, grapes, pineapples, etc. by changing the fruits and applying them to the game.
- You can compare records and compete with global users through the apple puzzle game.
- You can record your game information through the statistics function.
- You can play the game offline even without Wifi or network connection.
- You can enjoy the game without restrictions as there are no actions.
- Supports 16 languages.

snippet.title: Bubble Shooter Clash
snippet.description:
[Google Play Store]
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobirix.ldbsc

[Apple App Store]
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bubble-shooter-clash/id6744085994


It is a bubble shooter game where you can shoot bubbles and pop them all by connecting three or more bubbles of the same color.
Beat countless levels and set your own record.

[How to play and tips]
- When you touch the screen, a dotted guide is displayed, and when you release your hand, you can fire bubbles in the direction of the dotted guide.
- You can touch the circle at the bottom of the screen to change it to the next bubble.
- If you cannot remove all the bubbles at the top using the set number of bubbles for each level, the game is over.
- You can use cushions to bounce bubbles off the wall to pop bubbles that are hard to reach.
- You can cancel aiming by dragging the dotted guide towards the bottom.
- Press and hold the screen to see and shoot bubbles in a larger space.

[Game Features]
- Provides bubble stages with over 10,000 levels.
- You can aim the bubble accurately with one cushion.
- The endless mode provides a different enjoyment from existing bubble shooter games.
- Try attacking bubbles with various gimmicks, such as locks and deformation bubbles.
- Try to overcome difficult levels by using items that remove bubbles in a row or bubbles of the same color.
- Provides a leaderboard where you can set records and compete with other users.
- You can enjoy the game anytime, anywhere offline even without WiFi or network connection.
- You can enjoy the game unlimitedly as there is no action power.

snippet.description:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobirix.diff2

[Apple App Store]
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/difference-find-quest/id6744085906


Puzzle game to find the difference

Detailed description
This is an authentic puzzle game where you have to find 5 hidden differences in two pictures that look the same.
You can enter the game right away without any complicated process and find your mistakes, and since there is no action required, you can enjoy the game unlimitedly.

[How to play]
- Just touch the screen to find the difference in the picture.
- If you find all the wrong pictures, you will be moved to the next level.
- If you do not find all the wrong pictures within the time limit, you will fail the game.
- If you touch an incorrect spot, you will receive a time penalty.

[Game Features]
- Provides familiar photo background images that we can easily see around us.
- You can enjoy a huge amount of photos divided into various themes (interior, food, landscape, objects) as a game of spot-the-differences.
- You can enjoy challenge mode where you can challenge yourself to find the differences in 5 pictures at once.
- Provides a leaderboard where you can collect stars and compete with other users.
- You can use hint items to immediately find the mistake.
- You can enjoy the game anytime, anywhere offline even without WiFi or network connection.

When you combine the same fruits, they transform into larger ones.

– Tap a tube to pour water into another tube.
– You can only pour water on top of the same color.
– You can only pour water if there is enough space.
– You can move water of any color into an empty tube.
– Beat the level by collecting water of the same color in each tube.

– If you get stuck, you can retry the level.

FreeCell Solitaire helps develop intelligence.

The most fun FreeCell Solitaire game of the year is coming to you!
FreeCell Solitaire by Mobirix maintains the charm of the classic card game while adding modern design and innovative features to provide an amazing gaming experience.
You can enjoy the latest FreeCell Solitaire game anywhere with sophisticated high-resolution graphics and intuitive controls. 
The game is perfectly optimized for smartphones and tablets, and you can even personalize it with unique background settings.
If you like FreeCell solitaire, Klondike solitaire, Spider solitaire, Spiderette, Mahjong, Pyramid solitaire, Tripeaks or other Patience card games, play now

[rule]
- The goal is to sort 52 cards by pattern from A to K and move them to the 4 home cells (foundation piles).
- Only cards of different colors can be placed alternately.
- Cards must be stacked only in order from large to small numbers.
- If moving is difficult, you can temporarily store your card at Freecell.
- Free cell space affects the number of cards that can be moved.
- Think carefully about each move and prioritize moving cards that can be quickly moved to the home cell.

[characteristic]
- Faithfully implements the authentic Freecell Solitaire rules
- New random game every time
- Ranking competition with people from all over the world
- Unlimited play without limit
- Offline play support
- Right or left handed mode
- Auto save and resume function
- Auto-complete and card organization
- Unlimited undo
- Unlimited hints
- Detailed statistical support
- Customizing cards and backgrounds
- Multilingual support
- Smart hints and movement alerts
- Colorful and attractive design
- Full support for phones and tablets

It is designed to be fun for everyone, from beginners to experienced players. Download now and immerse yourself in the world of FreeCell where you won’t lose track of time!
